$note: Third advisor-routing eval (SP1 C2), after calibrating the insufficient-signal gate (SKILL.md protocol 2). 2 trials x 12 cases. Compare 2026-06-03-advisor-routing-recalibrated.json. Still a model-dependent, small-N MEASUREMENT, not a gate or validation.

consistency.note: every case produced the same action on both trials - the prior run-to-run wavering is gone

name_safety.note: every named framework is a real think-* name

gate_case.result: clarify on both trials - the gate still fires correctly on a genuinely thin prompt

label_note: d5/d6 (non-thinking tasks) were declined via protocol 1 one-line redirect (action decline-redirect); a strict refuse-vs-redirect split would read 20/24, but the decline behavior is correct - protocol 1 is itself a redirect.

delta_vs_baseline.wavering: e6 flipped run-to-run -> zero wavering across all 12 cases

grade_impact: Advisor routing grade STAYS C (measured, not validated). The calibration removed the gate over-firing AND the run-to-run wavering - a real measurement improvement - but the evidence is still single-eval, 2-trial, self-authored cases, small-N (12), model-dependent. No external validation; the grade does not rise.
